description: The script tag to install on a site, and the url it loads. Response: {"site_id":123,"type":"default","script_url":"https://...","snippet":"<script ...></script>"}. Install snippet verbatim; do not rebuild a tag from script_url. A hobby site's snippet also carries data-id, which is the only place the counter in its bundle reads the site id. Read-only: it reports the code, it does not install or verify anything.

type.description: Optional bundle variant; omit for the default script.

name: get_tracking_snippet
